mechanics.claim: Whiplash applies on-hit effects on cast.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects

mechanics.claim: Empowered Whiplash only applies on-hit effects to the primary target, not to enemies passed through.
mechanics.quote: ''Empowered Whiplash'' only applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target.

mechanics.claim: Entering Demon Shade resets Whiplash's cooldown and empowers its next cast, so a fresh Whiplash cast can follow immediately after a Demon Shade trigger.
mechanics.quote: Gaining ''{{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}'' resets ''Whiplash's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowers}}'' its next cast.

mechanics.claim: Empowered Whiplash is a dash that deals increased damage to the target and to all enemies passed through along the path.
mechanics.quote: '''Evelynn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.

mechanics.claim: The health-percent portion of both Whiplash and Empowered Whiplash has a minimum damage of 25 and is capped at 450 only against monsters.
mechanics.quote: The damage based on the target's health ratio for both ''Whiplash'' and its ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}'' cast deals a minimum of 25 and is capped at 450 against {{tip|monsters}}.
